```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(geosphere)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
# Define the airport
Airport <- c(
  -117.03023693175753, #l on
  32.543764371038556, # lat
  "Border", # airport name
  "SanYsidro", # terminal name
  85398 # throughput
)
```

```{r}
# backup
file.copy("demand_data.json.gz", "demand_data_backup.json.gz", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Open the target file
con <- gzfile("demand_data.json.gz", "rt")
json_text <- readLines(con, warn = FALSE)
close(con)

demand_data_1 <- fromJSON(paste(json_text, collapse = "\n"))
rm(json_text)
```

```{r}
# LM for number of pops
intercept <- -13.58889
slope     <- 122.88699

# Calculate pops which travel through the airport terminal
popsCount <- round((Airport[5] %>% as.numeric() - intercept) / slope)
```


```{r}
  decay_rate = 0.00003         # Exponential decay rate
  min_weight  = 1              # Minimum weight to avoid zero probabilities
  max_extent = 100000          

# Define the target points
points_1 <- demand_data_1$points %>%
  mutate(
    lon = as.numeric(sapply(location, `[`, 1)),
    lat = as.numeric(sapply(location, `[`, 2)),
    dist = distHaversine(cbind(lon, 
                               lat),
                         c(Airport[1] %>% as.numeric(),
                           Airport[2] %>% as.numeric())),
    # Compute relative demand using exponential decay
    dist_demand = exp(-decay_rate * dist) + min_weight,
    # Weighted demand = residents × relative demand
    dist_demand = ifelse(dist > max_extent, 0, dist_demand),
    # Adjust for residents
    weighted_demand = dist_demand * residents,
    # Normalise
    prop_demand = weighted_demand / sum(weighted_demand),
        # Initial allocation of jobs
    initial_jobs = prop_demand * popsCount,
    base_jobs = floor(initial_jobs),
    remainder_jobs = initial_jobs - base_jobs)

set.seed(111)

# Allocate remainder randomly, weighted by remainder_jobs
remainder <- popsCount - sum(points_1$base_jobs)

if (remainder > 0) {
  additional_indices <- sample(
    x = 1:nrow(points_1),
    size = remainder,
    replace = FALSE,
    prob = points_1$remainder_jobs
  )
  
  # Initialize final allocation
  points_1 <- points_1 %>%
    mutate(allocated_jobs = base_jobs)
  
  # Count how many times each index was sampled
  additional_count <- table(additional_indices)
  
  # Apply additional jobs
  points_1$allocated_jobs[as.integer(names(additional_count))] <-
    points_1$allocated_jobs[as.integer(names(additional_count))] +
    as.integer(additional_count)
  
} else {
  points_1 <- points_1 %>%
    mutate(allocated_jobs = base_jobs)
}
```

```{r}
airportPoint <- tibble(
  id = paste0("AIR_", Airport[3], "_", Airport[4]),
  location = list(c(as.numeric(Airport[1]) %>% round(4),
                    as.numeric(Airport[2]) %>% round(4))),
  jobs = as.numeric(Airport[5]),
  residents = 0,
  popIds = list((1:popsCount) + as.numeric(max(demand_data_1$pops$id %>% as.numeric(), na.rm = TRUE)))
)
```

```{r}
airportPops <- points_1 %>%
  filter(allocated_jobs > 0) %>%
  uncount(weights = allocated_jobs) %>%
  mutate(
    residenceId = id,
    jobId = airportPoint %>% pull(id),
    id = row_number() + max(as.numeric(demand_data_1$pops$id), na.rm = TRUE),
    drivingDistance = round(dist),
    drivingSeconds = round((drivingDistance / 60000) * 3600),
    rand_base = runif(n(), 70, 160),
    scaled = (rand_base / sum(rand_base)) * as.numeric(Airport[5]),
    size = round(scaled)
  ) 

# Redistribution logic
s <- airportPops$size
over_idx <- which(s > 200)

if (length(over_idx) > 0) {
  total_cut <- 60L * length(over_idx)
  s[over_idx] <- pmax(s[over_idx] - 60L, 1L)
  recipients <- setdiff(seq_along(s), over_idx)

  if (length(recipients) > 0) {
    add_each <- total_cut %/% length(recipients)
    remainder <- total_cut %% length(recipients)
    s[recipients] <- s[recipients] + add_each
    if (remainder > 0) {
      s[recipients[seq_len(remainder)]] <- s[recipients[seq_len(remainder)]] + 1L
    }
  } else {
    s[over_idx] <- s[over_idx] + 60L
    warning(glue::glue("residenceId {airportPops$residenceId[1]}: all rows > 200; no redistribution done"))
  }
}

airportPops$size <- s

airportPops <- airportPops %>%
  select(id, size, residenceId, jobId, drivingDistance, drivingSeconds)

```

```{r}
# edit existing points
points2 <- demand_data_1$points %>%
  left_join(airportPops %>% select(id = residenceId, size, airPopId = id), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(residents = ifelse(!is.na(size),
                            residents + size,
                            residents))

points2 <- points2 %>%
  mutate(
    popIds = map2(popIds, airPopId, function(x, y) {
      if (!is.na(y)) c(x, as.character(y)) else x
    })
  )

points2 <- points2 %>%
  select(-c(size, airPopId)) %>%
  bind_rows(airportPoint %>% mutate(jobs = jobs %>% as.integer(),
                                    residents = residents %>% as.integer()))
```

```{r}
# alter the demand data file
pops2 <- demand_data_1$pops

pops2 <- pops2 %>%
  bind_rows(airportPops %>% mutate(id = id %>% as.character()))

altered_demand_data <- demand_data_1

altered_demand_data$points <- points2
altered_demand_data$pops <- pops2
```

```{r}
# Convert to JSON string
json_out <- toJSON(altered_demand_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = FALSE)

# Write to compressed file
con_out <- gzfile("demand_data.json.gz", "wt")
writeLines(json_out, con_out)
close(con_out)
```
